rationale.oversight-explanation: Contextual explanations help programmers compare alternatives and judge generated code.
rationale.ai-review: Analysis LLM judges alternatives’ significance and incorrectness to focus verification.
rationale.automation-bias: Capable programmers accepted insecure suggestions; HILDe reduced uncritical reliance.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Controlled tasks measured security vulnerabilities in participants’ AI-assisted code.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented HILDe as a working VS Code extension.
rationale.assistive: Humans request and accept token-level inline completions piece by piece.
rationale.steering: Users select local tokens to directly shape ongoing code generation.
rationale.risk-security: Security mitigation and vulnerability outcomes are central to the evaluation.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Study measures and mitigates uncritical acceptance of AI-generated code.
rationale.method-self-report: Post-task surveys and semi-structured interviews collected participant reports.
rationale.method-experiment: Within-subjects controlled tasks compared HILDe against a baseline assistant.
